# tool result

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:toolResult`](gmeow-toolResult.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/toolResult>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/agentic`](../../slices/agentic.md)

The verbatim result payload the tool returned, byte-faithful — the PAYLOAD of the event, never a forward entity link: an entity the call produced links back via [`gmeow:wasGeneratedBy`](gmeow-wasGeneratedBy.md) ([Principle 5](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-5)). For large payloads store a content digest literal instead ('blake3:…'), as [`gmeow:toolArguments`](gmeow-toolArguments.md). Functional: one result record per call.
